crossRefs.note: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your…
Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of…
Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit…
No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
“ ‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

translations.web: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
translations.bsb: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
translations.asv: Thou shalt be blessed above all peoples: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
